simple.meaning: קֶרַח (qerach) is a Hebrew word meaning “ice (as if bald, i.e. smooth); hence, hail ; by resemblance, rock crystal.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קֶרַח (H7140) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 31:40, with occurrences in Genesis, Job, Psalms, Jeremiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶרַח (H7140) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קֶרַח (H7140) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קֶרַח (qerach) / H7140 is traced through Genesis 31:40, Job 6:16, Job 37:10, Job 38:29 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: ice (as if bald, i.e. smooth); hence, hail ; by resemblance, rock crystal

firstOccurrence.englishText: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

timeline.evidenceText: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
Which are black by reason of the ice,
By the breath of God, ice is given,
Whose womb did the ice come out of?
He hurls down his hail like pebbles.
Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

definitions.full: H7140. qerach קֶ֫רַח noun masculine Job 38:29 frost, ice ; — absolute ׳ק Gen 31:40 +, קָ֑רַח Job 6:16 +; suffix קַרְחוֺ Psa 147:17 ; — 1 frost of night (opposed to חֹרֶב of day), Gen 31:40 (E), Jer 36:30 . 2 ice , Job 6:16 ; 37:10 ; 38:29 (|| כְפֹר hoarfrost ), ק ׳מַשְׁלִיח כְפִתִּים Psa 147:17 (Hup and others think of hail, but see Bae; || קָרָה cold , כְּפוֺר שֶׁלֶג, 147:16 ); probably also ק ׳כְּעֵין Ezek 1:22 (so Krae; most crystal , after ᵐ5 ). קרִיּוֺת קִרְיַת, קִרְיָה, קְרִי, , etc., see קרה .
